players.product: Server chassis manufacturing and L11 server system assembly for data center operations, incl. AI GPU servers, NVMe storage servers and liquid-cooled AI GPU server platforms

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 income statement (2026 Investor Conference deck): sales revenue NT$839,415 thousand, up 21% YoY (Q1 2025: NT$692,836 thousand); gross profit NT$315,266 thousand (+76%); net operating profit NT$141,916 thousand (+147%); profit before tax NT$169,077 thousand (+192%); net income NT$122,952 thousand (+183%); basic EPS NT$1.33 (NT$0.48 a year earlier).
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue NT$839,415 thousand (+21%); net income NT$122,952 thousand (+183%); EPS NT$1.33

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue by product: Server NT$583,805 thousand, 69.55% of Q1 2026 revenue (2025: NT$1,894,240 thousand, 58.79%); Computer Chassis NT$171,640 thousand, 20.45% (2025: NT$944,800 thousand, 29.32%); Power Supply 3.34% (2025: 3.64%); Cooling 1.06% (2025: 1.42%); Others 5.60% (2025: 6.83%). Total 2025 revenue NT$3,222,227 thousand.

Revenue by region, Q1 2026: Taiwan NT$555,325 thousand (66.16%), APAC NT$123,382 thousand (14.70%), Americas NT$75,303 thousand (8.97%), EMEA NT$69,419 thousand (8.27%), Others 1.90%. 2025: Taiwan 54.39%, Americas 14.28%, EMEA 12.63%, APAC 9.79%, Others 8.91%.

Enterprise server solutions, described by the company as 'from component sourcing to system integration for data center operations': an AI GPU server (IW-RG658PRO), an NVMe storage server (IW-RS224-E3), a compact edge server (IW-MS07), a tower server (IW-PLG), a high-density storage expansion enclosure (IW-RJ424-07) and a liquid-cooled AI GPU server platform (IW-RL400). Its system integration service offers L11 manufacturing and assembly as a one-stop service: chassis manufacturing and system assembly, parts sourcing and chassis design, standardized or customized products, and firmware and software capability.

Manufacturing footprint (deck milestones, not dated in the deck): plants in Taiwan, the USA and Malaysia. The Changxing II factory was officially opened, significantly enhancing server system assembly capabilities, and server system integration reached L11 capabilities; the company completed the construction of a U.S. system assembly factory, its Malaysia factory is under construction, and the deck lists a Production Capacity Doubling Plan. It also added system assembly lines specifically for its growing IPC business. Its China unit In Shin signed a land repurchase agreement with the Jiangsu Province local government in accordance with regional planning.

Company profile: founded December 11, 1985; capital NT$925 million (as of April 30, 2026); net sales NT$3,222 million; 1001 employees; offices in Taiwan (HQ), the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, China and Malaysia. Balance sheet at March 31, 2026: total assets NT$6,299,921 thousand (NT$4,396,753 thousand a year earlier), total non-current assets NT$4,059,439 thousand (NT$2,336,836 thousand), inventories NT$607,492 thousand (NT$543,540 thousand), book value per share NT$25.54 (NT$21.51).
quarterly_data.figure: Total assets NT$6,299,921 thousand at March 31, 2026; 1001 employees

quarterly_data.signal: Non-server lines: commercial chassis (ATX, Mini-ITX and the CJ/CK mATX series); power supplies, including the VE / PFII / PII ATX 3.1 series that comply with Intel PSDG ATX 3.1 specifications with native 16-pin 12V-2x6 connectors and 80 PLUS Gold and Platinum certification; cooling (LYNX / Saturn modular fans, Neptune / AR AIO coolers); and retail signature chassis (D-Frame, S-Frame, Tou, H-Tower, WINBOT, ChronoMancy).
